messages:
Heda Johansson: Hi team — Heda here, starting today on SysOps (CEST). Quick intro: previously ran infra at a small CDN startup. Two quick asks: no MDM invite and laptop tracking shows "label created". Who should I poke?
Marta Li: Welcome Heda! :tada: Im Marta on DevEx. I can check SSO mapping and org invites. Can you confirm the email used to sign up?
Heda Johansson: Thanks Marta — heda.j@personalmail.com. Also I tried to access the internal docs but get a 403. Is that expected until SSO finishes?
Calvin (IT): Hey Heda  Calvin from IT. Laptop ETA tomorrow morning; label created usually means shipped. 403 is expected until you're in the "redwood-staff" group. I can add a temp role if you need docs now.
Sam Park: Hi Heda, Sam (SysOps lead). If you need console read-only we can grant a scoped role for the first 48 hours. Ping me your preferred GitHub username and I'll add it to the repo watchers.
Lina (People Ops): Welcome! :wave: I resent onboarding emails and badge pickup instructions to heda.j@personalmail.com. If you plan to visit HQ this week, let me know and I'll reserve a desk.
DevEx Bot: New-hire checklist created for Heda Johansson  tasks: SSO enroll, MDM, security training, channel joins (#sysops, #new-hires).
Heda Johansson: Confirmed I got the org Slack invite now. Enrolling MDM caused one prompt for a security key — is that expected?
Calvin (IT): Yes, we require device attestation. If enrollment errors, run: ```sudo /opt/redwood-mdm/enroll --debug``` and paste the last 5 lines here. I'll watch for the logs.
Heda Johansson: Enrollment succeeded, device shows as compliant in the portal. Also quick social note: I play clarinet in a community band and once accidentally marched in a parade with the wrong shoes :musical_score: 
Sam Park: Love the parade story. Welcome to SysOps — we'll set up a 1:1 and an intro pairing session tomorrow. I'll DM you access details for the scoped role.
Marta Li: Added Heda to the team runbook and onboarding calendar. Also posted a short "first-week checklist" in DM.
Heda Johansson: Perfect, thanks everyone! Looking forward to the pairing session and to meeting the band of SysOps in person.
